bib.title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation

question: Can one vision-language model serve both understanding and generation tasks, and can noisy web image-text pairs be cleaned by bootstrapping synthetic captions and filtering?
hypothesis: Noisy web text is a suboptimal supervision source; a captioner producing diverse synthetic captions plus a filter removing noisy ones yields a better pre-training corpus.
contributions: Multimodal mixture of Encoder-Decoder (MED): unimodal encoder, image-grounded text encoder, image-grounded text decoder, jointly pre-trained with ITC, ITM and LM losses
CapFilt: captioner and filter finetuned from the same pre-trained MED on COCO to bootstrap web data
State-of-the-art on retrieval, captioning, VQA, NLVR2, VisDial and zero-shot transfer to video-language tasks

method.summary: A ViT image encoder with a BERT-style text transformer is pre-trained with ITC, ITM and LM losses (MED). The pre-trained model is finetuned on COCO into a captioner (LM) and a filter (ITC+ITM); the captioner writes one nucleus-sampled caption per web image, the filter drops mismatched web and synthetic texts, and a new model is pre-trained on the cleaned set plus human-annotated pairs.
method.task: vision-language pre-training; image-text retrieval, captioning, VQA, NLVR2, VisDial, zero-shot video retrieval and QA

datasets.name: LAION
datasets.preprocessing: only images with shorter edge > 256 px; 1/5 of it used each epoch

datasets.name: VQA2.0
datasets.source: train+val used for training plus Visual Genome samples

datasets.name: MSRVTT / MSVD
datasets.source: zero-shot video; MSRVTT retrieval 1k test split

models.name: BLIP ViT-B
models.architecture: ViT-B/16 image encoder + BERT-base text transformer with cross-attention, encoder/decoder share all except self-attention
models.init_from: ViT pre-trained on ImageNet (Touvron et al. 2020; Dosovitskiy et al. 2021); BERT-base

other.param_counts_read_from_Table3: 224M all shared, 252M all except SA/CA, 361M none shared (14M-image web-text models)

models.name: Filter
models.architecture: image-grounded text encoder with ITM head

training.objective: ITC (momentum encoder, soft labels, as ALBEF) + ITM (hard negative mining) + LM (label smoothing 0.1)
training.lr_schedule: warm-up then linear decay with a rate of 0.85 (as printed)

other.image_resolution: random crops 224x224 pre-training, 384x384 finetuning (480x480 for VQA)
other.finetune_hparams: AdamW wd 0.05, cosine schedule. Table 14 init LR (ViT-L), batch, epochs: retrieval 1e-5 (5e-6), 256, 6; captioning 1e-5 (2e-6), 256, 5; VQA 2e-5, 256, 10; NLVR2 3e-5, 256, 15; VisDial 2e-5, 240, 20
other.capfilt_finetune: captioner and filter each finetuned on COCO; details beyond 'lightweight' not given
other.retrieval_rerank: top k by feature similarity then ITM rerank: k=256 COCO, k=128 Flickr30K
other.NLVR2: two cross-attention layers per block, average pooling in first 6 layers, concat + linear in layers 6-12
other.video: n=8 frames retrieval, n=16 QA, frame features concatenated

inference.decoding: CapFilt synthetic captions: nucleus sampling p=0.9, one caption per web image; captioning eval: beam search, beam size 3
inference.samples: one synthetic caption per web image; single runs, no seeds reported
inference.prompting: captioning: prompt 'a picture of' prepended to each caption

parameters.filter_rule: text noisy if ITM head predicts unmatched

eval.protocol: Single runs; no seeds or significance tests stated. Noise ratio = share rejected by filter.

availability.data: bootstrapped dataset released (per abstract and conclusion)

evidence.quote: decayed linearly with a rate of 0.85

limits: Captioner and filter are finetuned only on COCO, the domain of the COCO scores
No seeds or variance reported; single runs
Noise ratio is whatever the filter rejects, no human audit; diversity explanation for nucleus sampling is a hypothesis, not measured
Authors suggest untested next steps: multiple bootstrapping rounds, multiple captions per image, ensembles of captioners and filters
NLVR2 gains little from extra web images, attributed to a domain gap
SNLI-VE omitted because its test data is reported noisy

terms.definition: Captioning and Filtering: a dataset bootstrapping method with a captioner generating synthetic captions and a filter removing noisy ones
Multimodal mixture of Encoder-Decoder: a model operating as unimodal encoder, image-grounded text encoder or image-grounded text decoder

lineage.note: ITC with momentum encoder, hard negative mining, retrieval rerank, same 14M pre-training set; main baseline
